name: sol-neptune-graph
description: Authenticated Gremlin access to Sol's private Amazon Neptune graph.

interface.shortDescription: Use typed operations or Gremlin on Sol's private graph.
interface.longDescription: Use guarded typed semantic operations for routine persistence and OAuth-protected Gremlin tools for bounded inspection or exceptional graph work. Unknown mutation outcomes must never be retried blindly.
